sample_unit: pediatric anxiety cases and matched controls (clinical notes)

links.outcome: Model performance parity across sex subgroups in pediatric anxiety prediction
links.effect: Female adolescents showed 4% lower accuracy and 9% higher false-negative rates than males, hidden from aggregate performance; subgroup evaluation revealed systematic under-diagnosis.
links.quote: Here, we show systematic under-diagnosis of female adolescents, with 4% lower accuracy and 9% higher false-negative rates compared to male patients.

links.outcome: Reduction in diagnostic bias after applying de-biasing framework while preserving clinical content
links.effect: De-biasing framework (informative term filtering and gender-biased text replacement) reduced diagnostic bias by up to 27%, improving equity in model performance.
links.quote: Applying our de-biasing framework reduces diagnostic bias by up to 27%, improving equity in model performance.

unlisted_practices: Data-centric text de-biasing via gender-biased term replacement and normalizing information density in clinical notes
Using LIME to verify model relies on clinically relevant words

screen.reason: Empirical study evaluating equity/fairness in pediatric mental health NLP screening models, specifically testing a data-centric bias mitigation/safeguard practice to reduce demographic disparities across sexes.

primary.practice: data-centric bias mitigation via text replacement and term filtering
